Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend

name: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
storyline: From an unknown prospect to a place among basketball's elite, the player's career unfolds through training, games, contracts, relationships, and defining choices. Beginning on a College, International, or Pro path, each season reshapes the athlete's role and reputation as teams, rivals, coaches, agents, media, and national-team selectors respond to performance. There is no fixed script: success, setbacks, and the legacy left behind emerge from the player's decisions inside a living fictional basketball world.
summary: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend is a single-player basketball career simulator set in an original fictional universe. Create a prospect, choose a College, International, or Pro path, shape skills and mentality through RPG decisions, and earn a role through performance, form, and consistency. Play or simulate games in the Live 2D Match Center while teams, rosters, markets, standings, playoffs, records, contracts, coaches, agents, sponsors, injuries, media pressure, and national-team selections evolve across multiple seasons.
